title: Live captions from a phone call: a web page that shows each line with its real delay
summary: A live captions demo built to show a transcript stream rendered in a browser with its latency measured. The delay is computed on the server from the platform's timestamp, and the page can read one call but change nothing.
scenario: Open a web page while a call is running and watch captions appear, partial text in grey and finals solid, each with its measured delay
